question: Karnam Malleshwari won a bronze medal at which Olympic games ?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**2000 Sydney**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karnam Malleshwari** is an Indian weightlifter who made history by winning a **bronze medal** at the **2000 Sydney Olympics**.
 
• She competed in the **69 kg weight category**.
 
• Her win was historic as she became the **first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal**.
 
• Karnam Malleshwari's achievement brought significant attention to the sport of **weightlifting in India**.
 
• She lifted a total of **240 kg** (110 kg in snatch and 130 kg in clean and jerk).
 
• Her win inspired many young athletes, especially women, to take up sports and aim for international success.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **2004 Athens**__

 __
 
• The 2004 Athens Olympics saw India winning a single medal, a silver in shooting by **Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore**.
 
• It was a breakthrough moment for Indian shooting and inspired many future athletes.
 
 
 
• **2008 Beijing**__
 __
 
• At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, India won three medals: a gold by **Abhinav Bindra** in shooting, and two bronze medals by **Vijender Singh** in boxing and **Sushil Kumar** in wrestling.
 
• Abhinav Bindra's gold was India's first individual Olympic gold medal.
 
 
 
• **2012 London**__
 
 
• The 2012 London Olympics were India's most successful Olympics at that time, with a total of six medals.
 
• Medal winners included **Sushil Kumar** (silver in wrestling), **Vijay Kumar** (silver in shooting), **Mary Kom** (bronze in boxing), **Yogeshwar Dutt** (bronze in wrestling), **Gagan Narang** (bronze in shooting), and **Saina Nehwal** (bronze in badminton).
